sources.excerpt: Bowman Audio Endeavors Satan's Fingers Fuzz - Pedal of the Day Reviews Demos Buy a Pedalboard Interviews Contact Navigation Menu Menu Bowman Audio Endeavors Satan’s Fingers Fuzz Posted By Pedal of the Day on Friday, May 13, 2022 in Bowman Audio Endeavors, Fuzz | 0 comments --> --> Our pal James Bowman started Bowman Audio Endeavors a couple years back, and each new pedal release brings his unique spin on effects to the forefront. Today, we’re taking a look at the Satan’s Fingers Fuzz, a sinister and opaque piece of gear that has two knobs and a ton of noise. This one crushes from the moment it’s turned on – let’s see what it’s all about… Satan’s Fingers is a finely tuned Silicon Transistor fuzz pedal, with two control parameters, Volume & Fuzz. This simple setup lets you dial in nasally spit, reminiscent of your favorite smiley face fuzz, without having to ride your guitars volume knob. It’s easy to find the sweet spot between tight compressed fuzz and a total blown out mess as well. This effect is housed in a 125B sized flat black powder coated enclosure, as is printed with UV graphics. Each creation we’ve seen from Bowman Audio Endeavors has been completely different. From the Harmonic Percolator to the Fortune & Glory Boost to the klon-eque Overdrive , each has it’s own personality, and this one is no different. Two knob fuzzes have always been a blast to experiment with, and the Satan’s Fingers Fuzz keeps that tradition alive and thriving. Cheers to James and Bowman Audio Endeavors – be sure to check out their website for the latest sonic offerings, and hear this monster in action in our demo video below!!
